fact: The April 2024 KNMI peer review states ANACIM forecasters access EUMETSAT satellite products through a ground-based PUMA satellite receiver, use satellite products for nowcasting and short- and medium-range forecasts, and base early warnings partly on real-time satellite images, while no quality control process or QMS yet exists at ANACIM.
title: Country Hydromet Diagnostics: Senegal Peer Review Report
